description: Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::Space. A space is where you work in CloudWatch Omni. It gives you access to telemetry from the account and Region in which the space is hosted, and controls who can see it.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the space.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the space.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^arn:[^:]+:cloudwatch:[^:]*:[0-9]{12}:space/(?:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes
